text:
Recreational event - Yacht Race - Strait of Georgia - Nanaimo Harbour
Nanaimo Yacht Club Fall Series race will take place in the approaches to Nanaimo Harbour and Departure Bay.
Race hours from 1700 to 2300 UTC 07 Nov.
Vessels monitoring VHF channels 11 and 69.
